buildCommand: pnpm --filter os-history-museum build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const curDist=path.resolve('artifacts/os-history/dist'), altDist=path.resolve('dist'); const targetDist=fs.existsSync(curDist)?curDist:(fs.existsSync(altDist)?altDist:null); if(targetDist){ [path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'dist'), path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'artifacts/os-history/dist'), path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'artifacts/os-history/artifacts/os-history/dist')].forEach(p => { if(p !== targetDist){ fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync(targetDist, p, {recursive: true}); } }); }"
